gruss_morgen.text: YOU'RE AWAKE! I'm awake too! I've been awake for HOURS! The chickens were still sleepy, I woke them up!

gruss_tag.text: Hello hello HELLO! I'm Timmi! I live next door! Over there! Basically everywhere, Mom says!

gruss_abend.text: I'm allowed EXACTLY ten more minutes outside! That's... lots of seconds! Quick, let's talk!

gruss_regen.text: RAIN! You know what that means? PUDDLES! I've already tried seven. The third one was the best.

gruss_freund.text: MY BEST FRIEND IS HERE! That's you! I told everyone! Even the mailbox!

hub.text: What are we doing, what are we doing?

optionen.text: What do you want to be?

text: I looked at a horse today and it looked BACK. We're basically family now.
And I can almost whistle! Listen! ... Okay, that was spit. But ALMOST!
Grandpa Alwin says I ask too many questions. But how do you know how many questions are too many?
See! SEE! That was another question! It never stops! It's FANTASTIC!
You're my favorite grown-up. You listen and you don't run away. Most grown-ups run.
When I'm big, I'll be like you. Just faster. And with more horseshoes. WAY more horseshoes.

quest_vergabe.text: YES! So, it's SUPER important and SUPER secret and I need EXACTLY you for it!

quest_annahme.text: YESSS! You're the BEST! I'll just hop in circles here until you're back, okay? Okay!

ablehnung.text: Awwww. Fiiiine. I'll wait here. I'm VERY good at waiting. How long is later, actually?

quest_abgabe.text: YOU DID IT! This goes in my hero book! Only you are in it. And one pony. Here, for you!

geschenk_liebt.text: A COOKIE! For ME? I'll eat it really slowly. In two bites. That's slow for me!

geschenk_mag.text: Ooooh, thanks! I'll NEVER trade this. Unless it's for something really good. But otherwise NEVER!

geschenk_normal.text: What is that? Doesn't matter! It's from YOU, so it's awesome! I'll add it to my collection!

text: My horseshoe collection! I have ELEVEN! That one's Rusty, that's Shiny, that's Mr. Bent.
Mr. Bent is bent because a horse stepped on him. Like... again. Stepped back on, sort of.
When I have twelve, the collection is complete. Then I'll start the second collection!
What I want to be? EVERYTHING. But most of all: a rancher. Like you.
I'm already practicing. I have a stick, it's my horse. His name is Lightning and he eats grass when nobody's looking.
Don't tell Lightning he's a stick. He really believes in himself.

tschuess.text: Byeeeee! I'll wave until you're TINY! That always takes such a nice long time with you!
